name: canyonr-skills
description: Working modes, working docs and work-process skills: skills that change how an AI assistant thinks through a problem, carry work across sessions, and run steps of a workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Working modes that set how the assistant thinks for a session, working docs that carry work across sessions, and work-process skills for steps of a workflow.
interface.longDescription: Seven working modes (explorer, interrogator, evaluator, planner, implementer, troubleshooter, validator), each built on two named frames the model already knows, plus four working-docs skills (working-doc, handoff-doc, kickoff-prompt, handback-report) for work that outlives one conversation, and gtd-triage for clarifying and organizing a list of captured items. Modes are invoked by name and stay on until you switch.
defaultPrompt: Use explorer-mode to open this problem up before we decide anything
Write a handoff-doc for this session
